name: 2026-11-dashloom
description: This package is prepared to be used as a malicious loader. It pins pydash dependency in a vulnerable version allowing reaching out of the object scope when calling `pydash.invoke(...)`. The code to reach it is intended to be delivered from the now-benign GitHub file, which is then splited and passed to the vulnerable function. The same Github user account is also involved in publishing a repository that executes embedded encrypted code when called with specific arguments. The package was originally flagged by PyPI Security.
